console.title: Connect your Meta keys
console.subtitle: Attach your own Meta credit line to a customer's WhatsApp account so Meta bills you (the reseller), not them. Follow the two steps below; the guide on the right shows exactly where to get each value.
console.optionalBody: You only need this if you want Meta to bill YOU for your customers' messages. It requires Meta "Solution Partner" status and an approved Meta credit line. Until that's approved, everything still works: customers top up their wallet and you charge per message on Message pricing.
console.readOnly: You can look at this page, but only super admins can change it.

step1.title: Connect your Meta business
step1.tokenHint: Needs the business_management permission. Stored encrypted, never shown back.
step1.creditLine: Extended credit line ID (auto if blank)
step1.creditLineHint: Leave blank: we read it from GET /'{'business'}'/extendedcredits. Set it only to override.
step1.graphVersionHint: Default v26.0. Bump only after verifying compatibility.
step1.ratesEndpoint: Meta rates endpoint (optional, live cost pull)
step1.ratesEndpointHint: Optional. When set, "Sync Meta costs" on Message pricing pulls wholesale rates from here. Blank = use the bundled rate card / uploaded CSV.
step1.baseCurrencyHint: The currency of the income figures. Three letters, for example USD.
step1.autoAttachHint: ON (recommended): the moment any customer connects a WhatsApp number, your credit line is shared to it automatically, so you never pick customers by hand. OFF: you attach each one yourself in step 2.

invalid.autoAttachCurrency: Meta does not accept this currency.
invalid.baseCurrency: Use a three letter currency code.

step1.businessIdHint: Business settings → Business info → "Business portfolio ID". A long number.
step1.tokenNote: The token is stored encrypted and never shown back.

step2.title: 2. Attach one customer by hand
step2.hintAuto: Auto-attach is ON, so new customers attach themselves. Use this only for a one-off.
step2.hintManual: Or turn on auto-attach above and skip this entirely.
step2.attachAllBody: Attach your credit line to every connected number that is not attached yet?
step2.attachAllMore: {remaining} more are waiting. Run it again.
step2.empty: No customer has connected a WhatsApp Business (Cloud API) number yet. Once a workspace connects one under /devices, it will appear here to pick.
step2.locked: Locked once attached. Meta does not let you change the currency later, so set it right the first time.
step2.numberHint: Choose the customer by name: we handle the account IDs behind the scenes.
step2.currencyHint: The currency Meta invoices you in for this number.

register.title: Credit lines in use
register.empty: No accounts attached yet. Finish steps 1 and 2 above.
register.revokeBody: Meta stops billing you for this number and the customer pays Meta directly again.
register.revokeStillReseller: This workspace is still on reseller billing: its wallet keeps being charged per message while Meta bills the customer directly.
register.label: Credit allocations

guide.title: Where to get each value
guide.step1Body: Open business.facebook.com → Business settings → Business info. Copy the "Business portfolio ID".
guide.step2Body: Business settings → Users → System users → Add → role Admin. Then Generate token with these permissions:
guide.step3Body: You need Meta Solution Partner status and an approved credit line. Apply once with Meta:
guide.good1: Currency is locked by Meta once attached.
guide.good2: Attaching = Meta bills YOU; you still set customer prices on Message pricing.
guide.good3: Revoke any time: the customer then pays Meta directly again.
guide.step2Note: The token shows once, so copy it immediately.
guide.step3Note: Once approved, the platform reads its ID automatically and step 2 shares it with each customer WABA.

dashboard.title: Reseller P&L
dashboard.intro: Every billed message is a wallet charge. Revenue is what your customers paid; Meta cost is what Meta bills you; the gap is your margin. Prices & costs are set on <link>Wallet rules</link>.
dashboard.walletFloatHint: Money in customer wallets, all workspaces
dashboard.unpricedBanner: {count, plural, one {# billed message had} other {# billed messages had}} no Meta cost set for their country/category, so their margin is counted as pure revenue. Add those rows on <link>Wallet rules → Sync Meta costs</link>.
dashboard.empty: No billed messages this month yet.
dashboard.more: Only the top workspaces by revenue are listed.
dashboard.loadFailed: The P&L could not be loaded.
